entries.name: Ranger
entries.why: Proven to floor 35. The hawk keeps hitting, stacking Bleed and healing you through lifesteal.

entries.name: Dragoon
entries.why: Fastest simulated tower room: Sunder pops Rupture on every enemy, Spearhead stacks extra Bleed.

entries.name: Berserker
entries.why: Attacks hit every enemy while Frenzied, with lifesteal. Best tower sustain.

entries.name: Sellsword
entries.why: Fastest simulated boss kill: a sure crit every turn sets off Rupture.

entries.name: Pyromancer
entries.why: Burn on every enemy every turn, then Detonate. Not simulated yet.

entries.name: Assassin
entries.why: Best at stacking Bleed. Hidden plus Unseen Blade gives sure crits.

entries.name: Marksman
entries.why: Volley hits every enemy every turn. Not simulated for hit damage yet.

entries.name: Zealot
entries.why: Level 40+. Area Brand, extra actions and a self-healing ultra.

entries.name: Seraph
entries.why: Level 40+. Area damage plus full-party heals and revives.

entries.name: Gladiator
entries.why: Bloodsport adds Bleed, Favor adds crits. One target at a time.

entries.name: Outlaw
entries.why: Rob gives Haste. Works with Bleed but lacks a Rupture trigger.

entries.name: Gunner
entries.why: Scattershot Burns every enemy. Costs HP.

entries.name: Jester
entries.why: Mockery hits every enemy and makes them Vulnerable. Low damage alone.

entries.name: Skald
entries.why: Strong party buffs (Keen, Haste). Little damage alone.

entries.name: Oracle
entries.why: Undoes damage and revives. Support first.

entries.name: Duelist
entries.why: Strong one-on-one, poor against groups.

entries.name: Druid
entries.why: Single-target Poison and Regen.

entries.name: Priest
entries.why: Healer. Take it to reach the ultra classes at level 40.

entries.name: Knight
entries.why: Protects allies.

entries.name: Herald
entries.why: Gives allies extra actions.

entries.name: Sentinel
entries.why: Defensive support.
